backrooms.description: Backrooms: Blackhole is a cooperative psychological horror game for 1–4 players. Somewhere deep within the endless halls, reality begins collapsing into a growing void that consumes light, sound, and everything around it. The deeper you descend, the less the world makes sense — and the harder...
